method: Every post on the profile from Oct 9 was collected again: posts, quotes and retweets, with their full text, the quoted post and every image.
A vision model describes each image, so a token shown only on a chart or a token page is not missed.
Two separate AI readings (gpt-oss-120b) list every crypto reference and every possible call. Any token the author names himself, by ticker, address or chart, is checked too.

An arbiter decides each possible call three times and keeps it only when at least two decisions agree. The author must name a specific token and say where it goes next: praise of a past move, a platform or a retweet is not a call.
Each call is tied to one token address: the one written in the post, shown on the image, or used by this account for that ticker, and only if that token was trading in the 24 hours before the post.
Prices come from GeckoTerminal. Score = 50 + 5 points per % gained in the called direction, between 0 and 100, after 1 day, 1 week and 1 month, as for every call on the site.
Each post was also read one by one by Claude as a second check.
